concept: VPC endpoints: S3 gateway endpoint with no NAT or internet
tests: Choosing private access to S3 from a VPC, avoiding the internet and NAT data charges.
expected: Gateway VPC endpoint for S3 — a route table entry, free, traffic stays within the AWS network. Triggers: "without traversing public internet", "avoid NAT gateway data charges", "S3/DynamoDB".
why_not: An S3 interface endpoint is paid (hourly + per GB), mainly needed for on-prem access; NAT goes to the internet and charges for data; VPC peering doesn't apply to AWS services.
